items.title: UK and EU agree draft deal to scrap Brexit red tape over food exports
items.summary: The food deal, ahead of a UK-EU summit later this month, is the most significant part of the so-called Brexit reset agreed so far.

items.title: Cyber attacks affect UK meat processing industry, top security official says
items.summary: Cyber attacks have affected the UK meat processing industry, a top cyber security official has said in the wake of hacks that hit supermarkets across Europe.

items.title: Scientists detect signals at the smallest scale ever explored
items.summary: Researchers have detected signals from the smallest distances ever probed.

items.title: Spanish footballer dies after on-field collision
items.summary: Tenerife football player Jesus de Miguel has died after an on-field collision in a match on Monday, his club have announced.

items.title: Mahmood refuses to put cost on care worker settlement climbdown
items.summary: The home secretary says the full cost of dropping plans to extend the wait for settlement will be laid out in future.

items.title: Airlines warn budget raid will drive up passenger fares
items.summary: Britain's leading airlines have warned the government that a little-noticed budget measure risks pushing up airfares for passengers.
